references.text: The priest shall examine whether the rash has spread or remained in place, which determines if the person is clean or unclean.
The context of the boil (שְּׁחִין) and how the priest should examine the white spot (בַּהֶרֶת) that appears after the boil has healed.
A similar case where the spot has not spread and is a scar from a burn, and the priest declares the person clean.
Summary of the laws regarding various types of skin diseases, including white spots (בַּהֶרֶת) and scars.
